policy: At most two offline simulation processes on GPU0; later A comparisons share the same device after B completes. No other GPUs.
measurement_limitation: All potentially overlapping runs are conservatively marked shared-resource wall time. Physical control-step counts and optimizer counts remain exact. Do not rank computational speed from these wall times.
activation_boundary: Before first clearance followup; A y_only was active. Earlier B43 runs and full A train/eval were sequential.
